I want to finish the film in the ocean.
This is Sofia, she is an actress and singer.
She would be a great fit for your musical.
It is an erotic musical.
Sofia truly has a sublime voice.
I have never recorded professionally.
I am not looking for anyone famous.
I am looking for a sensual and vegetal voice.
Lows that evoke the Earth.
And highs like foliage.
Nature is important in his project.
It is a very erotic musical!
